title: Universal XSS in uBlock Origin from website-driven element picker
llm_summary: A security researcher discovered a universal cross‑site scripting (UXSS) flaw in the popular ad‑blocking extension uBlock Origin. By manipulating the extension’s “element picker” – a tool that lets users select page elements to block – an attacker can inject malicious JavaScript that runs with the extension’s privileges, potentially compromising any browser where uBlock Origin is installed.
